newsitem.title: USA: Revco extends tender for Big B.
newsitem.headline: Revco extends tender for Big B.

text.p: Revco D.S. Inc said on Friday its subsidiary RDS Acquisition Inc extended its $15 per share cash tender offer for all the outstanding shares of Big B until 1700 EDT on October 28.

Revco, the second largest drugstore chain in the United States, said as of 1800 EDT on October 24, 307,240 outstanding Big B common shares had been tendered. The offer had been scheduled to expire at 1700 EDT today.
Revco launched its bid for the regional drug store chain on September 9 but Big B has rejected the $332 million offer as inadequate.
This was the second time that Revco extended its tender offer for Big B.
